race.comment: IT IS TO BE (4) is knocking on the door and is desperate to break through. Hit the line well to grab third here two back against tougher opposition before not having much luck at Dubbo at the latest when only seeing clear air late. Drawn sticking but is right up to this. MISS DEFY (10) is the danger with the stronger distance profile, having won twice from four starts at the trip, and her Moruya fifth was a clear step in the right direction after a poor Dubbo run. MAYFAIR HOTEL (11) arrives off the most convincing recent win, scoring at Gundagai over 1800m with something in reserve. Distance is a slight query but she deserves following up. PHAROAH'S DAUGHTER (7) backs up quickly and will be doing his best work late again. The extra 200m might just suit him perfectly this time.
